_what: Verbatim responses kept as test fixtures. Recordings, not hand-written expectations. Sighting 28 survived twenty-two tests because the fixtures were written from what the author expected servers to send.

bodies.name: wzdx-registry
bodies.note: VERBATIM server response, complete. Not a hand-written fixture, which is the entire point.
bodies.why: G0 registry. 43 feeds; which are keyless is read from here, not assumed.

bodies.why: G0 registry. GTFS-Realtime sources with authentication_type per feed. Expect this one to exceed the cap.
